why_agent_cannot: an email confirmation link must be opened by the human
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the ZENi agent app Go to the ZENi agent app , which presents the New User Welcome Pack of 50 Airtime and 50 ZEN1.
2 Step 2 : Choose a login method Pick Login with Google, Login with X or Login with Email. The app offers three login options and shows no further task.
3 Step 3 : Read about the project The ZENi website describes the signal platform and the ZENI token if you want more context on the project.
